Rally uses MPVKit, libmpv, FFmpeg and their media dependencies.
MPVKit product: MPVKit (non-GPL), LGPL v3.0.
Source and build configuration: https://github.com/NuvioMedia/MPVKit/tree/bb1d0250ddcfa9d220761fcdad6011ac9fecf15e
libmpv: https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv/tree/v0.41.0
FFmpeg: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n8.1.2
Additional dependency versions, source locations, build instructions and binary
checksums are recorded in the pinned MPVKit package and its build scripts.
The MPVKit-GPL product is not linked into Rally.

Redistributors must preserve these notices and meet the applicable LGPL
relinking/source obligations. The Xcode project and pinned package are used to
rebuild the player. The device package links the media engines as replaceable dynamic frameworks.
Library replacement on iOS requires re-signing with your installation identity.
Preserve the corresponding source and build scripts at the exact versions above.
If packaging these libraries statically, provide relinkable application objects.
